name: shipping-rates-table
title: Shipping rates table
description: Where you ship and what it costs: regions, methods, prices, delivery times and the free-shipping threshold in one table, with a country picker.
docs: zones lists the regions in the order they should appear: region, countries (they fill the country picker; without them it lists the regions) and methods with name, price in minor units (0 is shown as Free, and its free-from cell says Always free), days (a number, a [fastest, slowest] pair or your own sentence, always in working days) and freeFrom, the order amount from which that method is free; a paid method without one shows a dash, read out as No free option. On a phone the Free from row is left out for both. Choosing a country marks its region's rows Your region in words as well as a tint and brings them into view; highlight starts with a country or a region already marked. cutoff is the dispatch cut-off in a sentence and notes are callouts under the table (customs, holidays, cut-off times). On a phone every region is a card with its methods and a description list, so nothing scrolls sideways. currency and locale format the amounts. headingAs is h2 by default; with h1 the region cards on a phone are h2. labels holds every word.
